Sikkim MP Raises Border Roads and Reservation Issues with Home Secretary

Sikkim Member of Parliament Indra Hang Subba met with the Union Home Secretary to discuss two key issues concerning his state. He raised concerns regarding the Limboo-Tamang reservation and pressed for progress on border road projects.
